# Mira story map

## Released

- S1 A shop owner sees today's report on the kiosk.

## Next release

- S2 A shop owner downloads the report as a CSV file.

## Deferred (not in the release plan)

- S9 A shop owner invites a second manager.
- S10 A shop owner downloads a report with a non-ASCII filename. Deferred until after Friday's demo at Mira Example's request on 2026-10-22; see [TASK-014](../../tasks/TASK-014.md) for demo scope.

# TASK-014 Customer export

Status: in progress

Outcome: a shop owner can export a report to a file and open it on their own computer.

## Notes

- The owner downloads from the report page.
- Export format: CSV, following [ADR 0011](../docs/adr/0011-reports-are-exported-as-csv-only.md).

## Demo scope

- Mira Example, 2026-10-22: ASCII-only filenames are acceptable for this task's Friday demo. This exception applies only to TASK-014.
- Follow-up: [S10 in the story map](../docs/journey/story-map.md#deferred-not-in-the-release-plan).
